diffs.diff: minimum supply: part 4.5 V, datasheet reading 5 V
diffs.evidence: The second reading copied only the vendor's nominal 'Operating Voltage: 5V' (HCMODU0115 board doc), which is a nominal value, not a limit. The module's DC+ feeds the G3MB-202P inputs directly, and Omron's G3MB datasheet (Input table) gives 'Rated voltage 5 VDC, Operating range 4 to 6 VDC'. The model's 4.5 V minimum is 5 V -10 %, which sits inside Omron's 4 V lower limit, so it is a conservative but correct range for a nominal 5 V module.

diffs.diff: maximum supply: part 5.5 V, datasheet reading 5 V
diffs.evidence: Vendor board doc says only 'Operating Voltage: 5V' and 'DC+: Connect the positive pole of the power supply (power supply according to the relay voltage)'; the relay is the 5 VDC G3MB-202P, whose Omron datasheet lists 'Rated voltage 5 VDC, Operating range 4 to 6 VDC'. The model's 5.5 V maximum (5 V +10 %) is below Omron's 6 V limit, so it is within spec; a 5 V/5 V range would wrongly reject any normal USB 5 V rail tolerance.
